name: Long Tongue
description:
You have a long, sticky tongue that can be thrust out to a length up to half your speed as a half action. The tongue automatically sticks to stationary objects and willing targets. Roll Dexterity vs Dexterity against unwilling targets. If the tongue does not stick to anything, it automatically retracts.

Once the tongue is stuck, it remains stuck until you use a full action to remove it or another creature uses a full action to roll Strength vs Strength against you to remove it (you may choose to forfeit the roll).

While stuck, you may use a full action to attempt to pull the stuck object toward you. Inanimate objects of less than half your body weight are automatically pulled to you. Heaver objects require a Strength check of a difficulty determined by the GM. Roll Strength vs Strength to attempt to pull an unwilling creature (they may also do the same to attempt to pull you).

Describe your tongue.
